run_groupby_cython_operation: run cython-based groupby aggregation or transform operations on numeric and datetime arrays
create_base_grouper: create a BaseGrouper to manage group indices, codes, levels, and result indices for pandas groupby operations
build_bin_grouper: build a BinGrouper for binned/time-based groupby with bin edges, labels, and indexer support
test_data_splitter: test DataSplitter that iterates over sorted group slices of Series or DataFrame for groupwise application
review_wrapped_cython_op: review WrappedCythonOp that dispatches aggregate and transform functions to pandas Cython _libs.groupby routines
